Welcome to Hotel Poonja International
Mangalore is a city bustling with commerce and industrial development. A center for education and banking. Abounding in cultural activity. Famous for its music and cuisine
Going with the concept of providing the best for leisure, family vacations as well as business travelers, Hotel Poonja International  has done well in blending the best possible amenities with the most important business facilities. Presenting a cheerful and inviting ambience, the hotel offers best of   amenities. Providing the best in hospitality, the hotel presents a dedicated staff who are ever ready to make you comfortable. Conveniently located in a prime area in the city, the hotel allows easy access to its guests to all the major industrial areas and is also well-connected to other places in the city.
Offering good dining and drinking options, the hotel has YUVRAJ  as their fine dining restaurant . At High Place , the bar, one can find a good selection of a wide range of refreshing beverages. Even when the hotel tries well to bring the best possible amenities under one roof, the aim of providing it at the best of rates is also their aim.
The grandeur and luxury of its appointments are a tribute to the Mangalore tradition of hospitality. Tasteful and cozy, Hotel Poonja International is upscale yet affordable
The 154 luxuries and well-appointed guest rooms at the Poonja International are tastefully furnished and designed to ensure your comfort. They include single, double rooms and deluxe suites as well. All the rooms are equipped with Free WiFi, telephone and flat screen TV.
